notes: All collect/ack_slot events are replayed, including local commands, not just completed network business chains. Reject missing, duplicate, out-of-order, over-limit or unretired ownership. Publication is GPU event4 for last payload or event11 for chunk6, after payload/tail publication; correspondence uses one remote peer, channel and issue ordinal. Nonpositive signed intervals are censored, not zero queueing; overlap and sampled clock uncertainty can both cause them. Percentages apply ONLY to positive fully covered intervals; report observed/censored counts before comparing backends. They describe software pending ownership, not hardware occupancy or a counterfactual speedup. Boundary timestamps include observer overhead. Per-workload controls are required on both nodes; global usable=False does not discard a different workload that passed.
